title: veil hook-mode stdout
description: What veil prints in hook mode (`veil < hook-payload.json`). The shape depends on the hook protocol detected from the payload. When veil has no reason to block a call, then for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and unknown protocols it prints nothing and exits 0: no decision, so the harness's own permission rules apply. This schema describes output that is printed, so for those protocols it is only ever a deny. Gemini CLI and Grok always get a reply, `allow` or `deny`, because neither reads `allow` as approval. When something is printed, it is exactly one object followed by a newline. A deny reason is present only on deny. Warnings go to stderr. A non-zero exit status is an error, not a decision.
